svg.title: Design sheet · Butterfly face
svg.text: Eyes closed. Body on the center line, upper wings over the brows and lids, lower wings on the cheeks. Lesson 04.3, project 2.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
On a real face: eye-safe paint only on the lids, and keep the lower wings below the lashes.
